content:
Lina Zhao: @team customer 'AcmePay' reporting spikes of 5xx from /v1/generate when they hit our rate limit. They expect 4xx 429 but see 500s. Happening since ~15:30 UTC.
Priya Singh: Can you paste sample request and response? Is this on hosted? Region us-east-1?
Lina Zhao: Hosted, us-east-1. Sample reply: "error": "internal_error", status 500. Token present. Sending curl in a sec.
Alex Chen: Tagging @kevin_pat - might be quota coordinator (ratecoord) path. We had a dependency timeout sweep earlier today.
Kevin Patel: I'm on it. Initial hunch: quota cache (redis/twemproxy) returning errors and the ratecoord code path returning 500 instead of mapping to 429. I'll look at logs.
SRE-Bot: Incident created INC-2026-8947 (sev2) by Lina Zhao
Lina Zhao: Customer is very upset; billing spikes and product page broken. They gave a replay script.
Priya Singh: Please prioritize. If it's a misroute to the admin backend we should revert routing.
Alex Chen: Pasting curl used to reproduce:
```
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-customer-acmepay" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-xl","input":"hello"}'
```
Response:
```
HTTP/1.1 500 Internal Server Error
Content-Type: application/json
{"error":"quota_service_internal","msg":"dependency timeout","code":500}
```
Kevin Patel: From logs:
```
2026-03-14T15:31:05Z ratecoord: request token=acct_acmepay seq=1 -> kv-get timeout (3002ms)
2026-03-14T15:31:05Z ratecoord: panic: UnhandledQuotaError -> returning 500
```
Kevin Patel: The bug is that when kv-get times out we throw UnhandledQuotaError and that bubbles as 500. Should map to a soft-fail that returns 429 or a local allow with annotation. I can push a hotfix to catch timeouts and return 429 with header X-Quota-Fallback: true.
Tom Rivers: Is this limited to a single availability zone? I see elevated latencies on redis-proxy in us-east-1b.
Alex Chen: I can deploy a temporary routing rule to force requests to prefer us-east-1a where kvs are healthy. Rollout 1% -> 100% within 10m.
Priya Singh: Customer wants immediate mitigation; please communicate ETA channel and set expectation.
Kevin Patel: Proposed mitigations:
- Short-term (5-15m): Catch kv timeout and return 429 + log (hotfix to ratecoord) - low-risk.
- Mid-term (30-60m): Reroute traffic away from us-east-1b and increase redis-proxy replicas.
- Long-term: Add circuit-breaker and map dependency timeouts to 429 or allow-secondary cache.
Lina Zhao: Can you include exact commands to reproduce for support? I'll attach to ticket.
Alex Chen: Repro steps:
1) export TOKEN=sk-customer-acmepay
2) for i in {1..50}; do curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/generate -d '{"model":"rwd-xl","input":"ping"}'; done
3) observe HTTP 500s intermittently; check ratecoord logs for kv-get timeouts.
Kevin Patel: Shipping hotfix branch `hotfix/kv-timeout-map-429` now. Will deploy to canary (us-east-1a) and test.
SRE-Bot: Deploy started: hotfix/kv-timeout-map-429 -> canary us-east-1a
SRE-Bot: Deploy success: canary -> 1 node healthy
Alex Chen: After canary, metrics show 429s increased and 500s dropped 95% for canary traffic. Proceeding to 50%.
Priya Singh: Communicated to AcmePay: temporary mitigation in progress; expect reduction in 20-30m. (customer thanked with :pray:)
Kevin Patel: Rollout to 100% complete. Monitoring.
Tom Rivers: Follow-up: found watch that redis-proxy in us-east-1b had slow GC due to recent config change. Reverting GC tuning.
Lina Zhao: Closing loop: Customer confirmed 500s are gone and they see 429 instead. They'll adjust client retry logic. Closing incident once downstream config change is stable.
Alex Chen: Action items follow-up:
- Kevin: PR for mapping dependency errors to 429 merged (RFC+tests) (#PR-4382)
- Tom: Revert redis-proxy GC tuning and add alert for proxy GC latency
- SRE: Increase redis-proxy capacity in us-east-1b
- Support: update KB article on quota error codes and guidance
SRE-Bot: INC-2026-8947 -> resolved (monitoring for 2h)
Lina Zhao: Nice work team :tada:
